nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token symbol, set to 'BBCC' in the constructor.
Public string state variable holding the token name, set to 'Big Block Coin' in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable holding token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint state variable holding the total token supply (1e27) assigned to the deployer MEW address.
Mapping of address => uint holding token balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping address => address => uint holding ERC20 allowances; mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Public address state variable holding the contract owner; set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Public address state variable used as the pending owner during the two-step ownership transfer.
SafeMath helper performing c = a + b followed by require(c >= a) to guard against overflow.
SafeMath helper performing require(b <= a) then c = a - b to guard against underflow.
SafeMath helper performing c = a * b followed by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) to guard against overflow.
SafeMath helper performing require(b > 0) then c = a / b to guard against division by zero.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the deployer as owner.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in the newOwner state variable.
Function requiring msg.sender == newOwner that finalizes ownership transfer, emits OwnershipTransferred and clears newOwner.
Token constructor that sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and credits the entire supply to a fixed MEW address.
Constant view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant view returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer that debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub, credits balances[to] via safeAdd and emits Transfer.
ERC20 approve that writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom that debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd.
Constant view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] then invokes ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with msg.sender, tokens, this and arbitrary data.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that calls ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary external token contract.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances, allowances and as an argument to external calls.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) made after state updates and with attacker-supplied callee and data.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary, owner-supplied token contract.
Unchecked addition c = a + b performed before the require(c >= a) validation in safeAdd.
Subtraction c = a - b guarded only by require(b <= a) in safeSub.
Unchecked multiplication c = a * b performed before the require(a == 0 || c / a == b) validation in safeMul.
Division c = a / b guarded only by require(b > 0) in safeDiv.
Parameter a of safeAdd, the first operand of the addition.
Parameter b of safeAdd, the second operand of the addition.
Parameter a of safeSub, the minuend.
Parameter b of safeSub, the subtrahend.
Parameter a of safeMul, the first multiplication operand.
Parameter b of safeMul, the second multiplication operand.
Parameter a of safeDiv, the numerator.
Parameter b of safeDiv, the denominator.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership, the staged successor owner.
Parameter to of transfer, the recipient address.
Parameter tokens of transfer, the amount to move.
Parameter spender of approve, the allowance beneficiary.
Parameter tokens of approve, the allowance amount.
Parameter from of transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter to of transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom, the amount moved and allowance consumed.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance, the allowance owner.
Parameter spender of allowance, the allowance beneficiary.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall, used both as allowance beneficiary and as the external callee address.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall, forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter data of approveAndCall, arbitrary bytes forwarded verbatim to the external callee.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token, the arbitrary external contract called.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token, the amount passed to the external transfer.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf, the queried account.
Named return local c of safeAdd holding the unchecked sum.
Named return local c of safeSub holding the difference.
Named return local c of safeMul holding the product.
Named return local c of safeDiv holding the quotient.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable inside the Owned constructor.
msg.sender becomes the privileged owner state variable that gates onlyOwner functions.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-controlled address.
msg.sender indexes into the balances mapping in transfer.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] for the caller.
msg.sender indexes into the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender] as the spender allowance.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by onlyOwner, i.e. msg.sender must equal owner.
safeAdd computes the unchecked addition represented by the arithmetic operation node.
safeSub computes the guarded subtraction represented by the arithmetic operation node.
safeMul computes the unchecked multiplication represented by the arithmetic operation node.
safeDiv computes the guarded division represented by the arithmetic operation node.
approveAndCall invokes an arbitrary external contract after writing allowance state, enabling reentrancy.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-supplied token contract.
Constructor assigns the symbol string state variable.
Constructor assigns the name string state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the _totalSupply state variable.
Constructor credits the whole supply to a hardcoded address in the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the total supply.
balanceOf returns the value read from the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer delegates the debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates the credit to safeAdd.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements the allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance entry.
allowance returns the value read from the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferOwnership stages the successor in the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership checks and then clears the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.

Spender parameter becomes both the allowance key and the external callee in approveAndCall.
